description:
The Firmstrong Siren Lady is an effortless beach cruiser built for women who want a smooth and stylish ride with a premium, coordinated look. This model is specially designed with matching color fenders and color-coordinated rims, giving the bike a seamless and high-end aesthetic that stands out on any beach path or city street. It features a slightly stretched frame and a relaxed pedal position that is ideal for riders between 5 feet 4 inches and 6 feet 4 inches tall. While the geometry is perfect for taller riders who need extra legroom, the comfort-first design remains stable and accessible for almost anyone looking for a laid-back experience.

What makes the Siren stand out is the Forward Pedal Design, which shifts the pedals slightly in front of the seat instead of directly underneath the hips. This allows you to push down and out while pedaling, giving your legs more room to stretch without needing to raise the seat to an uncomfortable height. Because of this layout, you can keep the seat closer to the ground while still getting full leg extension, making it much easier to put your feet flat on the pavement whenever you need to stop. The addition of the matching fenders not only enhances the timeless style but also provides practical protection by keeping water and debris off your clothes during your ride.

The overall feel of the Siren is clean and sophisticated, with a naturally upright riding position that takes the pressure off your back and shoulders. The color-matched rims complement the durable steel frame, ensuring the bike looks as good as it performs. Whether you are enjoying a casual spin through the neighborhood or a long cruise along the coast, the signature wide tires and cushioned saddle absorb road vibrations for a soft and relaxing journey. The Siren is built for the rider who values both fashion and function, offering a high-quality cruiser that provides a relaxed ride while letting you express your personal style.

17” Extended Length Steel Frame with 26” Painted Aluminum Wheels and Front/Rear Fenders

Great recreational riding bike for taller women or those who would like more leg and arm extension. 4” extended frame creates more space between rider and handlebars.

Forward pedaling design allows riders to keep seat closer to ground while still getting proper leg extension

Frame Geometry makes riders feel less cramped, creating a more “kicked back,” “relaxed” ride

Circular, High Arching Top Tube Frame Design

Dual Spring Oversized Seat for Added Comfort

2.125” Wide White-Wall Tires provide a cushioned, relaxed ride for easy rolling

28.5” Wide Chrome Plated Cruiser Bike Handlebars with Synthetic Leather Grips

Bicycle Weighs 36.5 lbs. Fully Assembled

Fits Most Women 5’4” – 6’4” Tall

Recommended Riding Speed 3 – 25mph

Recommended Riding Distance 0 – 35miles in a single trip

The Seat and Handlebar Height and Tilt can be adjusted to properly fit the rider

Bike comes 85% Assembled, Assembly is easy and fun!

Designed in Hermosa Beach, CA.
